mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the capillary sprout was most worthwhile: seeing it join another vessel and carry blood made the rebuilt supply understandable.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the new fibres felt a little repetitive after making them, though it showed that the deeper gap still needed support.

surprise.text: Closing the skin surface did not finish the repair; the deeper tissue still needed support and a blood supply.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary. The pictures and named slots made the pairings clear, although I followed the wound messenger picture without knowing the detailed mechanism of vessel growth.

continue.text: Yes. I would try another chapter because seeing separate repairs come together helped me understand how a wound closes and gets stronger.
